'''Chief Maulfist''' is an ogre found in [[Brol'ok Mound]] in [[Gilneas]]. He is vying for power amongst the [[Brol'ok]], with his chief rival being [[Shinban Four-Eyes]].

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Crown of Maulfist]] for {{questlong|Horde|45|A Chief Among Brutes}}.
